preserved_workflow_limits: The old local private archival ref was not present in the active case Git database. No private history or case data was fetched. A fresh sparse research checkout was prepared from the recorded already public preservation commit instead.

The new no-checkout worktree initially had an empty index. A status command displayed apparent staged deletions; there was no deletion of source files. Initialization from preserved HEAD completed before any new files were staged, and a separate check confirmed zero staged deletions. A later commit gate requires only this run's additive paths.

The operational media resolver reported the selected historical UAF PDF absent at that operational path. No fallback to retained archives, bare LFS pull, source-PDF hydration or media rewrite was used. This infrastructure observation is not evidence of author action or historical removal.
No PDF contents, figures, equations, native cases, semantic differences or later corrections were compared. No independent reviewer, blind model test or changed causal ranking is claimed.
The full institutional HTML was hashed but only selected link observations were retained, not its unrelated footer/contact text. Its shortened final-report link was not followed.
No third-party contact, litigation record changes, private disclosure, fees, archive-dataset retries or accepted Faraday engine-state changes occurred.
strongest_alternative: The two PDFs could be scientifically equivalent and differ only in PDF packaging or metadata. The present pin/HEAD evidence cannot adjudicate that possibility against content changes.
publication: Eligible for a separately named redundant copy and additive public commit as AveLyra. This pre-publication record does not itself claim that a push already succeeded.
